findings.title: No access keys exist for the root account
findings.remediation: Sign in as root and delete all root access keys; use IAM roles instead.

findings.remediation: Deactivate or delete passwords and access keys not used in 90 days: aws iam update-access-key --status Inactive

A multi-region CloudTrail trail is logging with log file validation
findings.message: Multi-region trail logging with log file validation.
findings.remediation: aws cloudtrail create-trail --name org-trail --s3-bucket-name <bucket> --is-multi-region-trail --enable-log-file-validation && aws cloudtrail start-logging --name org-trail

findings.title: No security groups allow 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 to SSH/RDP
findings.remediation: Remove the world-open ingress rule and restrict SSH/RDP to known CIDRs, or use SSM Session Manager instead of open admin ports.
